# Infrakinetic

> Infrakinetic is a modular business software platform from Polynovea.
> Companies can start with the business engines they need now - such as CRM & Sales,
> Billing & Invoicing, Finance, HR & Payroll, Customer Success, or Marketing - and add
> other engines later without rebuilding the surrounding operating model.
>
> Documents, Approvals, Workflow, Automation, Governance, and shared work infrastructure
> operate underneath enabled engines so those engines can share identity, authority,
> business context, events, documents, and governed handoffs without becoming one
> boundaryless application.

## Entity facts

- Parent organization: Polynovea
- Product: Infrakinetic
- Official product website: https://www.infrakinetic.in/
- Official parent website: https://www.polynovea.in/
- Product relationship: Infrakinetic is a Polynovea product, not a separate company or subsidiary.
- Product model: modular engines on shared platform infrastructure
- Adoption model: land and expand; customers do not need to buy every engine
- Brand/category language: connected business platform / business operating environment
- Core search categories: CRM software, sales software, billing software, invoicing software, finance software, accounting operations, HR software, payroll software, customer success software, document management software, workflow automation, approval workflow software, and CRM / ERP / HRIS data migration

## What is Infrakinetic?

Infrakinetic is a connected business software platform made of independently owned and
independently enabled business engines. A customer can begin with a focused starting
stack and expand over time. The platform experience stays connected because engines share
common identity, tenant context, governance, work, approvals, documents, business events,
and navigation while preserving clear ownership boundaries between business domains.

"Unified" does not mean every engine freely reads and writes every other engine's private
state. Canonical engines own their business records and expose governed contracts for
cross-engine work.

## How buying and expansion work

A customer does not have to adopt the whole platform.

Examples:

- CRM & Sales can be adopted as the commercial starting point.
- Billing & Invoicing can run without Finance enabled.
- Payments is independently entitled even though its product experience is closely connected to Billing.
- Finance can be added when the business needs general-ledger accounting, fiscal controls, reconciliation, and reporting.
- HR & Payroll can be adopted as a people-operations starting point.
- Customer Success can extend the commercial lifecycle when the relevant commercial foundation is present.
- New engines can be added later while continuing to use the same platform infrastructure.

## Platform infrastructure included with enabled engines

These are platform capabilities rather than another set of departmental applications the
customer has to assemble separately:

- Documents
- Approvals
- Workflow
- Automation
- Governance and access control
- Work / Tickets
- Shared identity and tenant context
- Notifications and operational evidence

Governed Migration is also part of the onboarding experience rather than an afterthought.

## Current product families

### CRM & Sales

Organizations, contacts, opportunities, proposals, commercial agreements, deal progression,
renewals, expansion and commercial handoffs.

### Billing & Invoicing

Billing rules and schedules, invoice generation, invoice documents, delivery, reminders,
collection state and manual payment recording. Billing is independently enabled and can run
without Finance.

### Payments

Provider connections, payment requests, payment observations, settlements, refunds,
disputes, chargebacks and reconciliation support. Payment-provider observations are not
silently treated as accounting truth.

### Finance

Accounting policy, journals, ledger/posting, budgets, fiscal controls, treasury/cash context,
reconciliation and financial reporting foundations. Finance owns accounting truth and remains
distinct from Billing and Payments.

### HR & Payroll

Employee records, workforce context, compensation, leave, payroll, payslips and governed
people operations.

### Customer Success

Customer lifecycle state, health signals, interventions, relationship context, renewal and
ongoing account continuity.

### Marketing

Campaigns, attribution, SEO intelligence, content operations and connected commercial context.

### Migration Engine

Governed onboarding for existing CRM, HRIS, finance/accounting, legacy database and file-based
data. It discovers and maps source structure, stages data away from production, executes in
dependency order, reconciles results, and requires explicit verification.

## In development / WIP

The website distinguishes complete-state direction from currently finished capability.

### Recruitment overhaul - In Development

The next-generation Recruitment experience is being rebuilt around job-description
understanding, requirement integrity, evidence-backed candidate matching, talent-pool
rediscovery, structured interviews and governed offers. Human recruiters and hiring managers
remain responsible for progression and hiring decisions.

### Finance experience expansion - In Development

Finance already has canonical ownership for accounting truth, ledger, budgets and
reconciliation. Broader Finance workspace and overhaul work is still being expanded and is
not represented as complete today.

## What does the Migration Engine do?

It discovers a source system's schema - entities, fields, relationships and custom structures -
models what the data represents, maps source structures to governed destinations, stages the
result in a separated airlock, executes in dependency order, and reconciles the outcome before
a human signs off.

Latest published execution benchmark, 28 Aug 2026:

- 30,000 rows x 30 columns
- 900,000 source data points
- 120,714 governed staging projections
- 107,114 eligible records executed
- 0 execution failures

Reconciliation and final human verification are separate evidence gates and were not represented
as complete for that benchmark.

## Why is this different from a CSV importer?

Real business systems contain relationships, custom fields and objects, duplicate entities,
historical state and lifecycle semantics. A field-to-field CSV import can move rows while still
breaking the meaning of the system. Infrakinetic treats migration as a governed systems problem:
discover, map, stage, execute, reconcile and verify.

## Architecture principles

- Canonical engine ownership: one engine owns each writable business aggregate and its invariants.
- Explicit cross-engine contracts: connected does not mean private cross-engine persistence access.
- Database-enforced tenant isolation for tenant-facing persistence.
- Shared Approval, Workflow, Documents, Automation and Governance infrastructure.
- Billing, Payments and Finance remain distinct business engines.
- AI output is bounded and must not bypass deterministic business controls.
- Important actions preserve evidence, attribution and governed state transitions.
